verdict.rationale: monday.com says it can automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule, which is a recurring schedule rather than a one-off trigger. Its developer platform also lists built-in cron for hosted apps. Both are one-line marketing claims, and most other automation evidence is event-triggered rather than scheduled. missing for 10: documented general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary workflows or agent runs, details on schedule configuration (intervals, cron syntax, time zones), any way to schedule jobs programmatically or from an AI agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Key-value storage, a pub/sub queue, cron, logs, and alerts out of the box.
